rationale: Revised plan corrects two critical parameter errors identified in evaluation feedback. denial_rate denominator changed from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to properly exclude pending claims (which have not been decided) and compute the rate over only adjudicated claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted statuses), yielding the expected rate value of ~0.1042 rather than ~0.1001. monthly_trend date_column changed from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to base the monthly volume trend on when care was provided rather than when claims were processed, eliminating lag-based inconsistencies in trend interpretation. All other components and parameters remain unchanged. Applied skills continue to enforce synthetic data disclosure, descriptive-only caveat, and citation discipline for executive communication.
changes_summary: Two critical parameter corrections: (1) denial_rate denominator 'all_claims' → 'adjudicated_claims' (feedback T11-denial_rate_denominator) to exclude unadjudicated pending claims and produce correct rate estimate; (2) monthly_trend date_column 'adjudication_date' → 'service_date_from' (feedback T11-monthly_date_column) to align trend analysis with service timing rather than processing lag.
